title: 1966 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Horse
seo_title: 1966 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Horse (21 January – 8 February 1967)
description: 1966 is the Year of the Fire Horse (Yang, Bing-wu), from 21 January 1966 to 8 February 1967. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1966.
lead: Born in 1966? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Horse, but check the date: the 1966 Fire Horse year began on 21 January 1966. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1966: Year of the Fire Horse, from 21 January 1966 to 8 February 1967.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1966 was the Year of the Horse. It began with Lunar New Year on 21 January 1966 and ended on 8 February 1967, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1966 ends in 6, which makes it a Fire year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1966 is a Bing-wu year. The same Fire Horse combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1906 before it and 2026 after it.
Lunar New Year 1966 fell on 21 January 1966. Anyone born from 1 January 1966 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Snake; from 21 January 1966 on, the Horse.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Horse guide describes the sign like this: “Energetic, independent, and adventurous. Horses love freedom and new experiences.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impatient or struggle to commit long-term.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Horse page.
Careers often linked with the Horse: travel, sales, sports, media.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1966
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Horse's best matches are the Tiger, Goat and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Horse, 2026 is a Horse year, so Horse people are in their own year (ben ming nian) until 5 February 2027.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Horse, it is listed as a supportive match of the Goat, so 2027 is traditionally a friendly year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Horse years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1954 (Wood Horse); 1978 (Earth Horse); 1990 (Metal Horse). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1966 is the Year of the Horse, a Yang Fire Horse year (Bing-wu).
When does the 1966 Year of the Horse start and end?
It starts on 21 January 1966 and ends on 8 February 1967.
I was born in January 1966. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 21 January 1966, you are a Snake; from 21 January 1966 on, a Horse.
Fire. 1966 ends in 6, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Horse compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Goat and Dog. The Horse's clash sign is the Rat.
